name: Amon
title: The Void Before the Altar
shortDescription: 1st-level vestige granting darkvision 60 ft., a 5-round cooldown fire breath line, and a natural ram horn attack (+1d8 on a charge).
description: Grants Darkvision 60 ft., Fire Breath (1d6/EBL fire in a 10 ft./EBL line max 50 ft., Ref half, 5-round cooldown), and Ram Attack (1d6 + 1.5x Str natural weapon; +1d8 on charge; requires Amon's sign).
text: Grants Darkvision 60 ft., Fire Breath (1d6/EBL fire in a 10 ft./EBL line max 50 ft., Ref half, 5-round cooldown), and Ram Attack (1d6 + 1.5x Str natural weapon; +1d8 on charge; requires Amon's sign).

spell.specialRequirement: Cannot bind if bound to Chupoclops, Eurynome, Karsus, or Leraje within the last 24 hours (or currently bound to any of them).
spell.vestigeSign: You grow a ram's curling horns.
spell.vestigeInfluence: Surly and irritable; must attempt a saving throw against even beneficial spells cast by followers of deities of fire, sun, or law.

kids.rider: +1.5x Str; +1d8 extra damage on charge (requires sign)

name: Aym
title: Queen Avarice
shortDescription: 1st-level vestige granting Dwarven Step, Halo of Fire (1d6), Improved Sunder, Medium Armor Proficiency, Fire Resistance 10, and Ruinous Attack.
description: Grants Dwarven Step (full speed in medium/heavy armor), Halo of Fire (1d6 fire on melee touch or to adjacent melee attackers), Improved Sunder feat, Medium Armor Proficiency, Resistance to Fire 10, and Ruinous Attack (2x melee damage to objects; adamantine vs DR at 10th EBL).
text: Grants Dwarven Step (full speed in medium/heavy armor), Halo of Fire (1d6 fire on melee touch or to adjacent melee attackers), Improved Sunder feat, Medium Armor Proficiency, Resistance to Fire 10, and Ruinous Attack (2x melee damage to objects; adamantine vs DR at 10th EBL).

spell.specialRequirement: None.
spell.vestigeSign: You bear a star-shaped brand on the palm of your left hand or forehead.
spell.vestigeInfluence: Stingy and greedy; must give a coin to every dwarf you meet within 10 rounds of learning their name.

kids.text: Gain Improved Sunder and Medium Armor Proficiency.
Dwarven Step: Move at normal speed without reduction while wearing medium or heavy armor.
Ruinous Attack: Deal double melee damage to objects; at EBL 10+, melee attacks count as adamantine for overcoming DR.

kids.condition: Melee touch attack or non-reach melee attackers striking you

name: Leraje
title: The Green Herald
shortDescription: 1st-level vestige granting +4 Hide, Low-Light Vision, Precise Shot, bow proficiencies, and Ricochet archery attack.
description: Grants +4 competence bonus on Hide, Low-Light Vision (or superior 3x if already possessed), Precise Shot feat, proficiency with composite/long/shortbows (+1 competence atk if already proficient), and Ricochet (single ranged attack against two adjacent targets, 1 attack roll).
text: Grants +4 competence bonus on Hide, Low-Light Vision (or superior 3x if already possessed), Precise Shot feat, proficiency with composite/long/shortbows (+1 competence atk if already proficient), and Ricochet (single ranged attack against two adjacent targets, 1 attack roll).

spell.specialRequirement: Must break an arrow crafted by an elf while calling Leraje's name and title. Will not answer if already bound to Amon.
spell.vestigeSign: Your skin becomes sallow and pockmarked.
spell.vestigeInfluence: Quiet and unassuming; forbidden from attacking any elf or creature of elven blood (half-elves, drow, etc.).

kids.what: Low-Light Vision (or 3x superior if already possessed)

kids.text: Gain Precise Shot and bow proficiencies (+1 competence atk if already proficient).
Make a single ranged attack roll and apply it to the AC of two adjacent targets (precision damage applies to one chosen target).

name: Naberius
title: The Grinning Hound
shortDescription: 1st-level vestige granting Disguise Self, Faster Ability Healing, untrained skill usage (Naberius's Skills), Persuasive Words, and Silver Tongue.
description: Grants Disguise Self at will, Faster Ability Healing (1 ability damage/round, 1 ability drain/hour), Naberius's Skills (Con bonus untrained trained-only skills), Persuasive Words (Command at will, Suggestion at EBL 14+, 5-round cooldown), and Silver Tongue (take 10 on Diplomacy/Bluff; rushed Diplomacy as standard action with no -10 penalty).
text: Grants Disguise Self at will, Faster Ability Healing (1 ability damage/round, 1 ability drain/hour), Naberius's Skills (Con bonus untrained trained-only skills), Persuasive Words (Command at will, Suggestion at EBL 14+, 5-round cooldown), and Silver Tongue (take 10 on Diplomacy/Bluff; rushed Diplomacy as standard action with no -10 penalty).

spell.specialRequirement: Must have at least 4 ranks in Bluff or in any Knowledge or Profession skill.
spell.vestigeSign: Your voice deepens and acquires a gravelly, growling tone.
spell.vestigeInfluence: Must seize any pulpit/stage/speaking floor to speak for EBL rounds and shout down or mock others.

kids.text: Faster Ability Healing: Heal 1 point of ability damage per round and 1 point of ability drain per hour.
Naberius's Skills: Choose Con-bonus skills; use them untrained for duration of pact.
Silver Tongue: Take 10 on Diplomacy and Bluff even if distracted/threatened; rushed Diplomacy as a standard action with no penalty.
Use disguise self at will (CL = EBL).
Command (Will negates); functions as Suggestion at EBL 14+.

name: Ronove
title: The Iron Maiden
shortDescription: 1st-level vestige granting Cold Iron/Magic attacks, Far Hand telekinesis, Feather Fall, Monk unarmed strike scaling (Ronove's Fists), and +10 ft. Sprint.
description: Grants Cold Iron & Magic Attacks (magic at 1st, cold iron at 7th EBL), Far Hand (move unattended objects at 10 ft./EBL, Str = EBL; or standard-action bull rush for 1d6 damage +2 bonus on 5-round cooldown), Feather Fall, Ronove's Fists (Improved Unarmed Strike + monk unarmed damage = EBL), and Sprint (+10 ft. enhancement to base land speed).
text: Grants Cold Iron & Magic Attacks (magic at 1st, cold iron at 7th EBL), Far Hand (move unattended objects at 10 ft./EBL, Str = EBL; or standard-action bull rush for 1d6 damage +2 bonus on 5-round cooldown), Feather Fall, Ronove's Fists (Improved Unarmed Strike + monk unarmed damage = EBL), and Sprint (+10 ft. enhancement to base land speed).

spell.specialRequirement: Ronove's seal must be drawn in soil under the open sky.
spell.vestigeSign: Your face settles into a fixed frown (good pact) or smile (poor pact).
spell.vestigeInfluence: Feel a constant need to prove your worth; cannot consume any food or beverages (including potions) while bound.

kids.text: Ronove's Fists: Gain Improved Unarmed Strike and deal unarmed damage as a monk of level = EBL.
Cold Iron and Magic Attacks: Melee attacks count as magic (EBL 1+) and cold iron (EBL 7+) for overcoming DR.
Automatically fall as under feather fall (suppress/activate as standard action).

kids.condition: Telekinetic Bull Rush push (Str mod = floor((EBL-10)/2) + 2; triggers 5-round cooldown)

name: Dahlver-Nar
title: The Tortured One
shortDescription: 2nd-level vestige granting Mad Soul (confusion/Wis damage immunity), Maddening Moan (daze 30 ft.), Natural Armor (+1/2 Con mod), and Shield Self (split damage).
description: Grants Mad Soul (immunity to Wis damage/drain, madness, insanity, confusion), Maddening Moan (30-ft. spread, Will or dazed 1 round, 5-round cooldown), Natural Armor enhancement equal to 1/2 Con bonus, and Shield Self (at will, target within 10 ft./EBL shares 50% of HP damage you take, Will negates).
text: Grants Mad Soul (immunity to Wis damage/drain, madness, insanity, confusion), Maddening Moan (30-ft. spread, Will or dazed 1 round, 5-round cooldown), Natural Armor enhancement equal to 1/2 Con bonus, and Shield Self (at will, target within 10 ft./EBL shares 50% of HP damage you take, Will negates).

spell.specialRequirement: None.
spell.vestigeSign: Several small teeth grow from your scalp.
spell.vestigeInfluence: Shift between distraction and focus; cannot undertake any task requiring more than 1 round of concentration.

kids.what: Wisdom damage, Wisdom drain, madness, insanity, confusion

kids.condition: One-half Constitution bonus (minimum 0)

kids.text: Mind-affecting sonic: Creatures within 30 ft. must succeed on a Will save or be dazed for 1 round.
Share HP damage 50/50 with target (Will negates if unwilling; 1 target at a time).

name: Haagenti
title: Mother of Minotaurs
shortDescription: 2nd-level vestige granting Confusing Touch (Maze at 19th EBL), Immunity to Transformation, Shield Proficiency (including tower), and Axe Proficiencies.
description: Grants Confusing Touch (melee touch, Will or confused 1 round/3 EBL; Maze at EBL 19+; 5-round cooldown), Immunity to Transformation (free action at start of turn to resume normal form vs polymorph/petrification), Shield Proficiency (including tower shields), and proficiency with battleaxe, greataxe, handaxe, throwing axe.
text: Grants Confusing Touch (melee touch, Will or confused 1 round/3 EBL; Maze at EBL 19+; 5-round cooldown), Immunity to Transformation (free action at start of turn to resume normal form vs polymorph/petrification), Shield Proficiency (including tower shields), and proficiency with battleaxe, greataxe, handaxe, throwing axe.

spell.specialRequirement: Must be Large size or larger, or able to speak Giant.
spell.vestigeSign: Your features grow uglier and your bulk increases until you weigh 50% more.
spell.vestigeInfluence: Bashful around attractive creatures; must show deference to any creature perceived as more attractive or charismatic.

kids.what: Permanent forced transformation (polymorph/petrification; resume true form as free action on turn)

kids.text: Proficiencies: Proficient with shields (including tower shields), battleaxe, greataxe, handaxe, and throwing axe.
Touch target: Will save or confused for 1 round per 3 EBL (functions as maze at EBL 19+).

name: Malphas
title: The Turnfeather
shortDescription: 2nd-level vestige granting Bird's Eye Viewing (scout raven/dove), Invisibility (scaling action), Poison Use, and Sudden Strike (+1d6 + 1d6/4 EBL).
description: Grants Bird's Eye Viewing (summon scouting dove/raven at will using raven stats), Invisibility (lasts EBL rounds; full-round at 1st, standard at 5th, move at 10th, swift at 15th; 5-round cooldown), Poison Use, and Sudden Strike (+1d6 + 1d6 per 4 EBL when target denied Dex; stacks with Sneak Attack).
text: Grants Bird's Eye Viewing (summon scouting dove/raven at will using raven stats), Invisibility (lasts EBL rounds; full-round at 1st, standard at 5th, move at 10th, swift at 15th; 5-round cooldown), Poison Use, and Sudden Strike (+1d6 + 1d6 per 4 EBL when target denied Dex; stacks with Sneak Attack).

spell.specialRequirement: None.
spell.vestigeSign: Your teeth and tongue turn black.
spell.vestigeInfluence: Fall in love too easily; must employ poison against foes at every opportunity if you have access to it.

kids.condition: Sudden Strike: +1d6 + 1d6 per 4 EBL when target denied Dex (30 ft. max ranged; stacks with Sneak Attack)

kids.text: Poison Use: No risk of poisoning self when handling or applying poison.
Bird's Eye Viewing: Summon one dove or raven (raven stats) at will and see/hear through its senses.
Become invisible for EBL rounds (ends on attack; 5-round cooldown after returning to visibility).

name: Savnok
title: The Instigator
shortDescription: 2nd-level vestige granting Call Armor (full plate scaling up to +4 heavy fortification), Heavy Armor Proficiency, Move Ally teleport swap, and Savnok's Armor (DR /piercing).
description: Grants Call Armor (at will full-round: 2-4 mw full plate, 5-8 +1, 9-12 +2 light fort, 13-16 +2 moderate fort, 17-19 +4 moderate fort, 20 +4 heavy fort), Heavy Armor Proficiency, Move Ally (swap places with willing ally within 5 ft./2 EBL; standard->move@7->swift@13; 5-round cooldown), and Savnok's Armor (DR (1 + floor(EBL/4))/piercing; becomes magic and piercing at EBL 13+).
text: Grants Call Armor (at will full-round: 2-4 mw full plate, 5-8 +1, 9-12 +2 light fort, 13-16 +2 moderate fort, 17-19 +4 moderate fort, 20 +4 heavy fort), Heavy Armor Proficiency, Move Ally (swap places with willing ally within 5 ft./2 EBL; standard->move@7->swift@13; 5-round cooldown), and Savnok's Armor (DR (1 + floor(EBL/4))/piercing; becomes magic and piercing at EBL 13+).

spell.specialRequirement: Must have stolen something and made neither reparations nor apology for that act.
spell.vestigeSign: A broken arrow point appears healed beneath your skin.
spell.vestigeInfluence: Headstrong and recalcitrant; once you don armor, shield, or AC-boosting item, you cannot remove it.

kids.what: piercing (magic and piercing at EBL 13+; while wearing called armor)

kids.text: Heavy Armor Proficiency & Call Armor: Summon full plate scaling from Masterwork (EBL 2-4) up to +4 Heavy Fortification (EBL 20).
Savnok's Armor DR: 1/piercing + 1 per 4 EBL (magic and piercing at EBL 13+).
Instantly swap positions with visible willing ally within 5 ft./2 EBL without provoking AoOs.

name: Andromalius
title: The Repentant Rogue
shortDescription: 3rd-level vestige granting Jester's Mirth, Locate Item, See the Unseen, Sense Trickery (+4 Sense Motive/Appraise/Spot vs Disguise), and Sneak Attack (+2d6 + 1d6/5 EBL >5th).
description: Grants Jester's Mirth (Tasha's hideous laughter, extra save each turn, 5-round cooldown), Locate Item (at will, 100 ft./EBL), See the Unseen (see invisibility at will), Sense Trickery (+4 Sense Motive, Appraise, Spot vs Disguise, auto-notice Sleight of Hand), and Sneak Attack (+2d6, +1d6 per 5 EBL beyond 5th; stacks with other Sneak Attack).
text: Grants Jester's Mirth (Tasha's hideous laughter, extra save each turn, 5-round cooldown), Locate Item (at will, 100 ft./EBL), See the Unseen (see invisibility at will), Sense Trickery (+4 Sense Motive, Appraise, Spot vs Disguise, auto-notice Sleight of Hand), and Sneak Attack (+2d6, +1d6 per 5 EBL beyond 5th; stacks with other Sneak Attack).

spell.specialRequirement: Place two nonmagical items matching those Andromalius holds within his seal when summoning.
spell.vestigeSign: You gain a sixth digit on each hand and foot (normal gloves won't fit).
spell.vestigeInfluence: Devious mischief-maker, yet forbidden from stealing, looting corpses, or possessing known stolen goods under law.

kids.condition: To oppose Disguise checks; auto-notice Sleight of Hand theft
Sneak Attack: 2d6 at 5th EBL, +1d6 per 5 EBL beyond 5th (3d6@10, 4d6@15, 5d6@20)

kids.text: See the Unseen: Use see invisibility at will (CL = EBL).
Locate Item: Sense direction of item within 100 ft./EBL at will.
As Tasha's hideous laughter (CL = EBL), target gets new Will save at end of each turn.

name: Focalor
title: Prince of Tears
shortDescription: 3rd-level vestige granting Aura of Sadness (-2 atk/saves/skills adjacent), Focalor's Breath (blind 1 rd), Lightning Strike (3d6 + 1d6/3 EBL >5th), and Water Breathing.
description: Grants Aura of Sadness (adjacent creatures take -2 penalty on attack rolls, saving throws, and skill checks), Focalor's Breath (30 ft. target, Fort or blinded 1 round, 5-round cooldown), Lightning Strike (at-will standard action within 10 ft./EBL dealing 3d6 + 1d6/3 EBL above 5th electricity, Ref half), and Water Breathing.
text: Grants Aura of Sadness (adjacent creatures take -2 penalty on attack rolls, saving throws, and skill checks), Focalor's Breath (30 ft. target, Fort or blinded 1 round, 5-round cooldown), Lightning Strike (at-will standard action within 10 ft./EBL dealing 3d6 + 1d6/3 EBL above 5th electricity, Ref half), and Water Breathing.

spell.specialRequirement: Focalor's seal must be drawn with a liquid medium.
spell.vestigeSign: Your eyes constantly weep regardless of mood.
spell.vestigeInfluence: Act morose; whenever you kill a creature, spend a round speaking words of sorrow at the first peaceful moment.

kids.text: Aura of Sadness: Adjacent creatures take -2 penalty on attack rolls, saving throws, and skill checks (mind-affecting; suppress/activate as standard action).
Target must succeed on a Fortitude save or be blinded for 1 round.

kids.condition: 3d6 + 1d6 per 3 EBL above 5th

name: Karsus
title: Hubris in the Blood
shortDescription: 3rd-level vestige granting Heavy Magic (+2 item save DCs), Karsus's Senses (detect magic aura), Karsus's Touch (touch dispel/suppress item), and Karsus's Will (use wands/staves).
description: Grants Heavy Magic (+2 DC on all magic item effects you use), Karsus's Senses (detect magic auras within 30 ft. on concentration), Karsus's Touch (melee touch dispel magic 1d20+EBL max+20 or suppress magic item 1d4 rounds, EBL/day, 5-round cooldown), and Karsus's Will (use spell trigger items like wands/staves as wizard of EBL).
text: Grants Heavy Magic (+2 DC on all magic item effects you use), Karsus's Senses (detect magic auras within 30 ft. on concentration), Karsus's Touch (melee touch dispel magic 1d20+EBL max+20 or suppress magic item 1d4 rounds, EBL/day, 5-round cooldown), and Karsus's Will (use spell trigger items like wands/staves as wizard of EBL).

spell.specialRequirement: Cannot summon within area of an active spell; requires Knowledge (arcana) 5 ranks or Spellcraft 5 ranks; hates Amon.
spell.vestigeSign: You bleed profusely from even minor scratches (cosmetic).
spell.vestigeInfluence: Arrogant; must use Bluff or Intimidate rather than Diplomacy to influence others.

kids.text: Heavy Magic: Increase the save DC of every magic item effect you use by +2.
Karsus's Will: Use spell trigger items (wands, staves) as a wizard of level equal to EBL.
Karsus's Senses: Detect magic auras within 30 ft. (dazzled if overwhelming aura is in range).
Melee touch dispel check (1d20 + EBL, max +20); magic items suppressed for 1d4 rounds (usable EBL/day, 5-round cooldown).

name: Paimon
title: The Dancer
shortDescription: 3rd-level vestige granting +4 Dexterity, +4 Tumble/Perform (dance), Uncanny Dodge, Whirlwind Attack, Rapier/Short Sword Finesse, and Dance of Death.
description: Grants Dance of Death (move up to speed attacking each foe passed once, 5-round cooldown), Paimon's Blades (rapier/short sword proficiency + Weapon Finesse with them), Paimon's Dexterity (+4 Dex), Paimon's Skills (Tumble untrained, +4 Tumble & Perform (dance)), Uncanny Dodge (or Improved), and Whirlwind Attack feat.
text: Grants Dance of Death (move up to speed attacking each foe passed once, 5-round cooldown), Paimon's Blades (rapier/short sword proficiency + Weapon Finesse with them), Paimon's Dexterity (+4 Dex), Paimon's Skills (Tumble untrained, +4 Tumble & Perform (dance)), Uncanny Dodge (or Improved), and Whirlwind Attack feat.

spell.specialRequirement: None.
spell.vestigeSign: One side of your mouth stretches wide and tends to drool.
spell.vestigeInfluence: Lascivious and bold; must dance at half speed whenever you hear music.

kids.condition: Tumble usable untrained

kids.text: Gain Whirlwind Attack, Uncanny Dodge (or Improved), and proficiency + Weapon Finesse with rapier and short sword.
Move up to your speed and make a single melee attack against each creature you move past (provoking AoOs normally; max 1 attack per target).

name: Agares
title: Truth Betrayed
shortDescription: 4th-level vestige granting Earth and Air Mastery (+1 atk/dmg), Earthshaking Step (10 ft. prone), Elemental Companion, Fear Immunity, and True Speech.
description: Grants Earth and Air Mastery (+1 atk/dmg if both grounded; -1 penalty to airborne foes attacking you), Earthshaking Step (10-ft. Reflex or fall prone, 5-round cooldown), Elemental Companion (Earth Elemental: Small 1-10, Medium 11-14, Large 15-18, Huge 19+ EBL), Fear Immunity, and True Speech (understand/speak/read/write languages within 30 ft.).
text: Grants Earth and Air Mastery (+1 atk/dmg if both grounded; -1 penalty to airborne foes attacking you), Earthshaking Step (10-ft. Reflex or fall prone, 5-round cooldown), Elemental Companion (Earth Elemental: Small 1-10, Medium 11-14, Large 15-18, Huge 19+ EBL), Fear Immunity, and True Speech (understand/speak/read/write languages within 30 ft.).

spell.specialRequirement: Seal must be drawn upon earth or an expanse of unworked stone.
spell.vestigeSign: Wracking cough spewing dust and small stones (prevents spells with verbal components; resist Con-score rounds).
spell.vestigeInfluence: Speak forthrightly; cannot use Bluff and must answer direct questions truthfully.

kids.condition: When both you and foe touch the ground (-1 atk/dmg to airborne foes vs you)

kids.text: Elemental Companion: Summon an earth elemental (Small 1-10, Medium 11-14, Large 15-18, Huge 19+ EBL) within 30 ft.
True Speech: Speak, understand, read, and write any language heard spoken within 30 ft. (cannot lie in unfamiliar tongues).
Creatures within 10 ft. standing/climbing on ground-connected surfaces must make a Reflex save or fall prone.

name: Andras
title: The Gray Knight
shortDescription: 4th-level vestige granting heavy warhorse Mount (1/day), +8 Ride, Smite Good/Evil (Cha atk, +EBL dmg), Sow Discord, Sure Blows (Improved Critical), and martial blade/lance proficiencies.
description: Grants proficiency with greatsword, lance, longsword, rapier; Mount (heavy warhorse with saddle & heavy lance 1/day, 1 hr/EBL); Saddle Sure (+8 Ride); Smite Good or Evil (+Cha atk, +EBL dmg, 5-round cooldown); Sow Discord (Will or enemy attacks adjacent ally within 5 ft./2 EBL, 5-round cooldown); Sure Blows (Improved Critical with all weapons, or +4 confirm).
text: Grants proficiency with greatsword, lance, longsword, rapier; Mount (heavy warhorse with saddle & heavy lance 1/day, 1 hr/EBL); Saddle Sure (+8 Ride); Smite Good or Evil (+Cha atk, +EBL dmg, 5-round cooldown); Sow Discord (Will or enemy attacks adjacent ally within 5 ft./2 EBL, 5-round cooldown); Sure Blows (Improved Critical with all weapons, or +4 confirm).

spell.specialRequirement: None.
spell.vestigeSign: You sprout two useless gray-feathered wings from your back.
spell.vestigeInfluence: Listless and remote; must drop items and withdraw from melee after 10 rounds of combat for 1d4 rounds.

kids.text: Weapon Proficiency & Sure Blows: Proficient with greatsword, lance, longsword, rapier; gain Improved Critical with any weapon (+4 crit confirm if already possessed).
Summon a heavy warhorse with saddle and heavy lance for 1 hour per EBL.

kids.condition: During Smite melee attack
Extra damage equal to EBL on Smite

kids.text: Mind-affecting compulsion: Will save or enemy attacks a random adjacent ally on its next turn.

name: Buer
title: Grandmother Huntress
shortDescription: 4th-level vestige granting +4 Heal/Kn.(nature)/Survival, Disease/Poison Immunity, Delay Diseases & Poisons (30 ft. aura), Fast Healing 1->5, Healing Gift, and Track.
description: Grants Buer's Knowledge (+4 Heal, Knowledge (nature) untrained, Survival), Buer's Purity (immunity to disease/poison + cures existing), Delay Diseases & Poisons (30-ft. ally aura), Fast Healing (1; 2@10, 3@13, 4@16, 5@19), Healing Gift (standard 1 hp at will; full-round 1d8+EBL max 1d8+10 on 5-round cooldown), and Track feat.
text: Grants Buer's Knowledge (+4 Heal, Knowledge (nature) untrained, Survival), Buer's Purity (immunity to disease/poison + cures existing), Delay Diseases & Poisons (30-ft. ally aura), Fast Healing (1; 2@10, 3@13, 4@16, 5@19), Healing Gift (standard 1 hp at will; full-round 1d8+EBL max 1d8+10 on 5-round cooldown), and Track feat.

spell.specialRequirement: Buer's seal must be drawn outdoors.
spell.vestigeSign: Your feet turn into satyr's hooves (normal boots don't fit).
spell.vestigeInfluence: Momentary memory lapses; first melee attack against living foes (non-animal/vermin) must be nonlethal; no coup de grace.

kids.condition: Knowledge (nature) usable untrained

kids.what: Disease and Poison (plus cures existing on binding)

kids.condition: Fast Healing 1 (2@10th, 3@13th, 4@16th, 5@19th EBL)

kids.text: Gain Track feat and Delay Diseases & Poisons (allies within 30 ft. ignore failed saves while in aura).

kids.condition: Full-round heal 1d8 + EBL (max +10), 5-round cooldown; or Standard action 1 hp at will

name: Eurynome
title: Mother of the Material
shortDescription: 4th-level vestige granting Animal Friend, DR 2/lawful, Eurynome's Maul (Large one-handed scaling up to +3 anarchic adamantine), Poison Blood, and Water Dancing.
description: Grants Animal Friend (animals start friendly), DR 2/lawful, Eurynome's Maul (swift summon Large warhammer 2d6 x3 in one hand: <=10 +1, 11-14 +1 anarchic, 15-18 +1 anarchic adamantine, 19+ +3 anarchic adamantine), Poison Blood (bite/swallow deals 1d6 / 1d6 per 3 EBL max 5d6 secondary), and Water Dancing (water walk self at will).
text: Grants Animal Friend (animals start friendly), DR 2/lawful, Eurynome's Maul (swift summon Large warhammer 2d6 x3 in one hand: <=10 +1, 11-14 +1 anarchic, 15-18 +1 anarchic adamantine, 19+ +3 anarchic adamantine), Poison Blood (bite/swallow deals 1d6 / 1d6 per 3 EBL max 5d6 secondary), and Water Dancing (water walk self at will).

spell.specialRequirement: Hates Amon; will not answer if already bound to Amon.
spell.vestigeSign: Clammy skin leaving moist prints that evaporate after 1 minute.
spell.vestigeInfluence: Paranoid and ungrateful; cannot attack a foe unless an ally has already attacked it (if allies are present).

kids.text: Animal Friend: All animals have an initial attitude of friendly toward you.
Poison Blood: Creatures biting or swallowing you take 1d6 primary / up to 5d6 secondary (1d6 per 3 EBL) Fort save poison damage.
Water Dancing: Walk on liquid as firm ground at will (self only).

kids.rider: Wielded one-handed; +1 (<=10), +1 anarchic (11-14), +1 anarchic adamantine (15-18), +3 anarchic adamantine (19+)

name: Tenebrous
title: The Shadow That Was
shortDescription: 4th-level vestige granting Deeper Darkness, See in Darkness, Touch of the Void (+1d8 cold +1d8/4 EBL >7th), Turn/Rebuke Undead, and Vessel of Emptiness (Flicker).
description: Grants Deeper Darkness (centered on self, unlimited duration, at will), See in Darkness (perfect vision in any darkness), Touch of the Void (swift action, +1d8 + 1d8/4 EBL >7th cold; full round at EBL 11+; 5-round cooldown), Turn/Rebuke Undead (as cleric of EBL, 5-round cooldown), and Vessel of Emptiness (flicker mystery Su 1/day, 2/day@13, 3/day@19).
text: Grants Deeper Darkness (centered on self, unlimited duration, at will), See in Darkness (perfect vision in any darkness), Touch of the Void (swift action, +1d8 + 1d8/4 EBL >7th cold; full round at EBL 11+; 5-round cooldown), Turn/Rebuke Undead (as cleric of EBL, 5-round cooldown), and Vessel of Emptiness (flicker mystery Su 1/day, 2/day@13, 3/day@19).

spell.specialRequirement: Must draw Tenebrous's seal at night or in an area of deep shadow with little or no daylight exposure.
spell.vestigeSign: You stand in shadow even in daylight, and your shadow never extends more than a few feet.
spell.vestigeInfluence: Sense of detachment and loss; never act first in combat (if highest initiative, must delay until another acts).

kids.text: Deeper Darkness centered on self (unlimited duration, shift range up/down 10 ft. as move action).

branches.targetText: Next melee attack (entire round at EBL 11+)

kids.condition: 1d8 + 1d8 per 4 EBL beyond 7th (lasts entire round at EBL 11+)
